The Stolen Signet

Objective: Retrieve the stolen signet and leave through the reliquary's far exit.
Type "help" for available commands.

Session: playing.

You stand at the entrance to a ruined watchtower. Rain beads on the old stone.
Visible features: ruined archway.

Guardroom

Combat begins against the goblin.
